data.name: Consuela
data.gender_notes: Consuela is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Latin, Consuela means 'consolation of God'. It is derived from the Latin words 'consolare' (to console) and 'Deus' (God). The name was commonly given to girls born during times of hardship or loss, as a reminder of the comfort and solace found in God. The name Consuela carries the meaning “Consolation of God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Consuela usually hope their child will grow to embody consolation of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of God's unwavering presence and comfort during life's trials.
data.etymology: Consuela belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Consolation of God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Consuela total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
